facts.claim: The evening's last telegram, an Aigle apothecary's promise of morphia and quinine on the first clear funicular, comes up just before the line is cut.
facts.quote: a supply order acknowledged from Aigle, the apothecary promising morphia and quinine on the first clear funicular

facts.claim: Roeder carries a small black diary with a brass lock, the kind kept when a man does not trust his own desk.
facts.quote: a small black book with a brass lock, of the kind a man keeps when he does not trust his own desk

facts.claim: The house master key hangs on the warden's board in Gaspard's office; Roeder keeps the only working private key on his own ring.
facts.quote: the house master key, he reminded her, hung where it always hung, on the warden's board in Gaspard's office

facts.claim: A small brown medicine bottle, its label turned away and a third gone, stands by Roeder's open hand.
facts.quote: stood a small brown medicine bottle, its label turned away, perhaps a third gone

facts.claim: Alone with the body, Nurse Brandt draws a buff chart by its old number and feeds it into the consulting-room stove.
facts.quote: she drew one out by its number, which she knew without reading ... and she ... fed the folder in

facts.claim: The patient 'Madame Hélène Surel' holds forged admission papers: a referral from a Lausanne physician who does not exist, a name that is not hers.
facts.quote: a letter of referral from a Lausanne physician who did not exist, a name that was not her name

facts.claim: Roeder's unsent resignation to the Berne board breaks off: 'health' struck out, 'and of conscience' written over it and struck through, no third word.
facts.quote: over it, in the same upright hand pressed harder, he had written *and of conscience,* and struck that through as well, and not found a third word

facts.claim: The funicular maintenance log has a gap: the daily inspection signed every dawn, then nothing at all across the day before the storm.
facts.quote: across the very day before the storm, nothing at all. No entry, no signature, no line drawn to mark the omission.

facts.claim: A single pair of Lindqvist's boots is found soaked through outside the sick-wing door, though Lindqvist swears he has not gone out of doors.
facts.quote: stood a single pair of gentleman's boots, soaked through and rimmed white with melted snow-salt

facts.claim: The morphine ledger does not balance: grains entered out under Roeder's hand do not match the doses the patients' charts record receiving.
facts.quote: The grains entered out did not match the grains entered back.

facts.claim: A surname in the living admission register answers exactly a surname cut into the sanatorium's burial record six years before.
facts.quote: A name on the register of the living that answered, exactly, a name in the book of the dead.

facts.claim: Lindqvist's chart shows a dying engineer abruptly written well a fortnight since, in Roeder's hand.
facts.quote: until a fortnight since, when in Roeder's hand the curve simply turned, and a dying engineer was abruptly written well

facts.claim: An avalanche cuts the funicular and the telegraph line; Belvoir is shut for three weeks.
facts.quote: a great weight of snow let go of the mountain ... the line was cut

facts.claim: Cendre meets Roeder alive on the gallery landing at ten, locking his consulting-room door.
facts.quote: Cendre met him once more alive, on the gallery landing at ten

facts.claim: Roeder's door is bolted with his private key inside the lock; Gaspard brings the master key, cold from the board, to open it.
facts.quote: The private key was in the lock on the inside ... the heavy old key ... was cold from the board

facts.claim: Roeder is found dead at his desk, dead for hours, a brown bottle at his open hand.
facts.quote: No pulse, none for hours; the jaw and the hands already set

facts.claim: With the line dead and the pass shut, Cendre is the only physician on the mountain for three weeks.
facts.quote: on the mountain exactly one person licensed to sign for a life or against it

facts.claim: Under the borrowed name 'Surel', the patient is the sister of a man Roeder wrote into a ledger and crossed out; she came to make him answer.
facts.quote: the sister of a man who had come to Belvoir to be cured and had gone instead into the sanatorium's own ground

facts.claim: Cendre assays the brown bottle: strong morphia, a mouthful enough to stop a strong heart within the hour; a third gone.
facts.quote: morphia in solution, and not the timid solution one spoons to a wakeful patient

facts.claim: The room was shut from inside: iced sash, unmarked sill, bolt drawn, master key untouched; the poison had only to arrive before the bolt.
facts.quote: The poison did not need a murderer in the room. It only needed to have arrived before the bolt.

facts.claim: Gaspard remembers being called to the cable-house by a written word in a hand like Roeder's, for a fault that was not there, emptying his post the day before the storm.
facts.quote: a hand that could pass for his had emptied the one office from which the mountain's one road was watched

facts.claim: The wet boots are packed at the toe with folded paper: someone with a smaller foot crossed the snow as Lindqvist.
facts.quote: Someone had gone out *as* Lindqvist

facts.claim: Cendre reads the shape: misconduct off the register, paid in morphia and at least one grave, and a death that closed the books on it.
facts.quote: Roeder's own misconduct, and a death that closed the books on it.

facts.claim: The ledger reads two ways: Roeder spent the morphia on his own off-book cases, or the hand that measured the doses drew more than the wards received.
facts.quote: The discrepancy looked two ways at once and would not choose.

facts.claim: Cendre must choose: confront Brandt with the ledger, or interview the patients quietly.
facts.quote: Two roads lay open from the ledger, and she could walk only one of them first

facts.claim: The green morphine ledger has lived behind Roeder's locked door, under his authority.
facts.quote: the long green morphine ledger that had lived behind his door

facts.claim: Custody of the morphine ledger passes from Roeder's authority into Cendre's keeping; she signs the foot of the page.
facts.quote: Custody passed now from Roeder's authority into Cendre's keeping

facts.claim: The brown bottle stands on the blotter by Roeder's dead hand.
facts.quote: near the open hand, stood a small brown medicine bottle

facts.claim: Cendre winds the brown bottle in lint and carries it to her own locked drawer.
facts.quote: wound it in lint, and carried it down to the locked drawer of her own room

facts.claim: Roeder tucks the brass-locked diary into the breast of his coat.
facts.quote: The diary's brass lock caught the candlelight when he tucked it into his coat.

facts.claim: Cendre takes the brass-locked diary from the dead man's coat and sets it aside, to her drawer, unforced.
facts.quote: she could not open it, and would not force it, and set it aside on the desk

facts.claim: The unsent resignation lies under Roeder's blotter.
facts.quote: The unsent letter she found under the blotter

facts.claim: Cendre takes the unsent resignation up the stair into her own keeping.
facts.quote: Two she took up the stair: the brass-locked diary ... and the unsent letter

facts.claim: The forged admission papers lie in Hélène's writing-case.
facts.quote: In the writing-case on her knees lay the admission papers that had brought her up the mountain

facts.claim: Gaspard finds the boots outside the sick-wing door and sets them by his office stove to dry.
facts.quote: the steward had found them outside the sick-wing door at first light and brought them in to dry

facts.claim: Cendre carries the boots up to the light and sets them in her own room with the rest of the evidence.
facts.quote: She set the boots in her own room with the rest of it

facts.claim: Roeder is alive the night of the storm.
facts.quote: It was the last she saw of him on his feet

facts.claim: Roeder is dead.
facts.quote: No pulse, none for hours

facts.claim: Herr Edvard Lindqvist is alive, a wintering consumptive patient.
facts.quote: Herr Edvard Lindqvist, a Stockholm engineer six months consumptive

facts.claim: Confronted with the ledger, Brandt says the grains went where Roeder sent them: cases of his own, off the wards' books, that she carried too.
facts.quote: If they did not reach the wards, Doctor, it was because he kept cases of his own — off the books you have been reading

facts.claim: Brandt confesses she burned a chart in his stove the morning he was found, a thing that would have shamed him and the house.
facts.quote: I burned a chart ... In his stove, the morning we found him.

facts.claim: The cellar archive holds no discharge of the missing folder: the earlier 'archived' account was a lie; it was burned.
facts.quote: The folder Brandt had once sent her imagination down here to find had never come down here at all.

facts.claim: Cendre sets a thin blade to the diary's little lock and breaks it, opening Roeder's own record.
facts.quote: set a thin blade to the little lock, and broke it

facts.claim: The diary confirms the morphia, drawn under his name, went into the arms of a chosen few behind his door.
facts.quote: into the arms of a chosen few, behind his own door, after the wards were dark

facts.claim: Cendre sets the two Surels side by side: the buried one was Roeder's subject; the living one is kin, come for it.
facts.quote: She was kin to the crossed name. She had come for it.

facts.claim: The papers of the woman in the lower room are forged, by someone with a reckoning to keep.
facts.quote: The papers in the writing-case of the woman in the lower room were forged, and forged by someone who had a reckoning to keep.

facts.claim: The snow-wet boots too small for the engineer were a woman moving about the outside of the house she meant to enter.
facts.quote: the snow-wet boots too small for the bed-bound engineer ... A woman moving about the outside of a house

facts.claim: The steward was drawn from his post by a note in a hand like Roeder's, the cable left unwatched.
facts.quote: the steward drawn from his post by a note in a hand *like* Roeder's, the cable left unwatched

facts.claim: The diary shows the unfinished resignation, halting on conscience, had its long rehearsal there, draft after draft.
facts.quote: the unfinished resignation under his blotter, halting on the word *conscience,* had its long rehearsal here, draft after draft

facts.claim: The last telegram had promised resupply only on the first clear funicular; then the line died and no more morphia was coming until the thaw.
facts.quote: the last telegram up from Aigle had promised the resupply only on the first clear funicular, and then the line had died

facts.claim: The master key never left its board because Roeder never meant it to; no hand reached him, for he bolted the door against every hand.
facts.quote: The master key never left its board because he never meant it to.

facts.claim: Roeder measured himself a strong draught into the unlabelled brown bottle and drank it, bolting the door upon the world.
facts.quote: He had measured himself a strong draught into the unlabelled brown bottle

facts.claim: Lindqvist still breathes; his improving chart was the last of Roeder's false vigours, the method's one surviving subject.
facts.quote: Lindqvist still breathed, the improving chart over his bed the last of Roeder's false vigours

facts.claim: Ending A: Cendre certifies death by his own hand, of a mind broken by the knowledge of his own conduct.
facts.quote: Death by his own hand ... while of a mind broken by the knowledge of his own conduct

facts.claim: Lindqvist's 'new strength' was the morphia's warm hour behind the private door, dressed in his chart as a cure.
facts.quote: She read his 'strength' for what it was — the poppy's warm hour, dressed in a chart as a cure

facts.claim: An old patient recalls that Roeder's favoured evening cases, across the winters, had a way of not lasting.
facts.quote: the favoured ones had a way of not lasting

facts.claim: Asked gently of the repeated name, Madame Surel gives a candid-shaped nothing: a wide family, a kinsman gone for the cure.
facts.quote: a kinsman, she allowed — distant; the family was wide and scattered

facts.claim: Cendre lays register and burial book together and writes the Surel match into her notebook as a sorrow and not a suspicion.
facts.quote: She wrote the match into her notebook as a sorrow and not a suspicion

facts.claim: With the evening needle stopped at Roeder's death, Lindqvist's borrowed strength drains and the true wasting coast is bared.
facts.quote: the borrowed strength drained back the way a tide goes

facts.claim: On the quiet road Cendre cannot bring herself to force the diary; the little brass key is on no ring she can find.
facts.quote: The little brass key was on neither ring she could find

facts.claim: The case forks: Hélène will either confess her name and purpose, or keep silence while a second death escalates the case.
facts.quote: a confession, or a silence with another death growing in it

facts.claim: Hélène confesses: her papers are forged, Surel is her own name, and the man in the ground was hers; she came to stand where he died.
facts.quote: My papers are forged ... The man you found in your ground was mine, Doctor.

facts.claim: Hélène names the buried Surel as her brother, spent behind the consulting-room door; she pushes the forged papers across.
facts.quote: He was one of the ones taken behind the consulting-room door for the needle and the borrowed hour

facts.claim: Hélène swears she never passed the bolt; with the one hand that wished him dead outside the door, the sealed room shows its suicide face.
facts.quote: His door was bolted ... I never passed it. I set no glass by his hand.

facts.claim: Cendre forces the diary at last: a thin blade and a steady hand, and the little mechanism gives.
facts.quote: A thin blade and a steady hand, and the little mechanism gave with a dry click

facts.claim: The diary shows the morphia drawn off the ledger for the evening needle and the borrowed hour.
facts.quote: The morphia drawn off the ledger for the evening needle

facts.claim: The diary's last pages show the resignation drafted and redrafted, always failing on the same word.
facts.quote: the resignation drafted and redrafted and never finished, always failing on the same word

facts.claim: The diary's final entry: he had measured the strong draught into the brown bottle, meaning to drink it and bolt his door.
facts.quote: He had measured the strong draught into the brown bottle.

facts.claim: The sealed room, the cold key and the residue all say no one had killed Augustin Roeder but Augustin Roeder.
facts.quote: no one had killed Augustin Roeder but Augustin Roeder

facts.claim: On the confess road the death is suicide by his own conscience-dose behind the bolt.
facts.quote: The man inside had drawn that bolt against the whole world and then against himself.

facts.claim: Hélène confesses she took the engineer's boots, packed the toes with paper, and went out in them learning the ground.
facts.quote: She had taken the engineer's boots from the sick-wing ... packing the toes with paper

facts.claim: Hélène confesses the note that drew Gaspard to the cable-house for a fault that was not there.
facts.quote: the note that drew Gaspard to the cable-house for a fault that was not there

facts.claim: Hélène watched the last telegram come up and lie unanswered on the salver before the line went dead.
facts.quote: she had watched the last telegram come up and lie unanswered on the salver

facts.claim: Lindqvist's improving chart was the method's last fiction; with the needle stopped he is failing, but alive, and Cendre will chart him honestly.
facts.quote: Lindqvist's improving chart had been the method's last fiction ... But he was alive

facts.claim: On the confess road the burning of the chart stays outside Cendre's knowing: she never goes to Brandt, and the hand that took the folder is never learned.
facts.quote: the burning itself stayed outside her knowing ... the one secret of the house that even this gentlest solving never reaches

facts.claim: Ending B: Cendre certifies death by his own hand, of a conscience he could not carry, and keeps Hélène's forged papers as a survivor's testimony.
facts.quote: death by his own hand, of a conscience he could not carry

facts.claim: Shut out of the woman, Cendre sets the boots beside the mute witnesses: a smaller foot, an unwatched cable, an unanswered telegram — a person about the outside of the shut house.
facts.quote: someone who had moved about the outside of this shut house near the hour it shut

facts.claim: Lindqvist is found dead in the small hours, gone too suddenly for the slow ebb of withdrawal: a breath pinched out.
facts.quote: Lindqvist was dead ... a breath had been pinched out rather than let run down

facts.claim: The chart still says 'improving' in Roeder's hand: held up on a fiction and let fall, then hurried out of the world by a hand.
facts.quote: held up on a fiction and let fall when the fiction's author died

facts.claim: Lindqvist died in an open sickroom; a hand that could reach the second bed gives the first its missing visitor — a dose set ready before the bolt.
facts.quote: let them lend each other a murderer

facts.claim: The murder was laid, not committed: the dose set ready hours before in the brown bottle Roeder would lift to his own mouth.
facts.quote: the dose that stopped the doctor had only to be set ready, hours before, in the brown bottle

facts.claim: The cold untouched master key, iced sash and inner bolt told her only that the killer did not need to enter.
facts.quote: They had only told her the killer did not need to enter.

facts.claim: On the escalate road the death is murder: a dose composed by someone who knew Roeder's habits, set where habit would do the rest.
facts.quote: A dose composed by someone who knew his habits, set where habit would do the rest.

facts.claim: The snow-wet boots, worn through the drift by a foot too small for the man whose name they bore, are the murderer walking the snow in another's boots.
facts.quote: The snow-wet boots, worn through the drift by a foot too small for the man whose name they bore

facts.claim: The funicular log gone blank: the steward drawn off his post by a note in a hand got up to look like Roeder's, emptying the cable-house.
facts.quote: the steward drawn off his post by a note in a hand got up to look like Roeder's

facts.claim: The last telegram come and gone unanswered, then the line dead and the house shut, are the movements of a single careful person.
facts.quote: The last telegram come and gone unanswered, and then the line dead and the house shut

facts.claim: The ledger's missing grains fed years of the evening needle and spared a strong last dose or two for a clever hand.
facts.quote: morphia enough ... to feed years of the evening needle and to spare a strong last dose or two

facts.claim: On the escalate road Cendre sets the missing folder down to misfiling and never guesses it had gone to the stove; the burned chart's owner stays the reader's, not hers.
facts.quote: the buff folder she had set down to misfiling and never guessed had gone to the stove

facts.claim: On the escalate road the buried Surel's kinship to the living patient stays the reader's and not hers; she takes the shared name for sad coincidence.
facts.quote: the buried Surel's kin ... stayed the reader's and not hers

facts.claim: The halted resignation reweighs as motive: a physician about to confess the method was one someone had reason to silence; his conscience served the hand that killed him.
facts.quote: Even his conscience, in the end, had served the hand that killed him.

facts.claim: On the escalate road Cendre never opens the diary; the seal holds and the case keeps its hole.
facts.quote: on the escalate road she never opened it ... the case kept its hole

facts.claim: Ending C: Cendre certifies both deaths as 'death by a hand unknown'; the murderer, Hélène, rides down unnamed and unproven.
facts.quote: She wrote, for Roeder and for Lindqvist both, *death by a hand unknown*

facts.claim: Edvard Lindqvist is dead.
facts.quote: Lindqvist was dead.
